hooks.command: p=$(jq -re '.tool_input.file_path // empty') || exit 0; root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$p" in /*) abs="$p" ;; *) abs="$root/$p" ;; esac; case "$abs" in "$root"/*) rel="${abs#"$root"/}" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$rel" in .claude/skills/*|.claude/rules/*|.claude/agents/*|.claude/hooks/*|.claude/apm-hooks.json|.claude/settings.json|.codex/skills/*|.codex/rules/*|.codex/agents/*|.codex/hooks/*|.codex/hooks.json|.cursor/skills/*|.cursor/rules/*|.cursor/agents/*|.cursor/hooks/*|.cursor/hooks.json|.agents/skills/*) echo 'BLOCKED: That path is an APM deploy target and is overwritten by apm install, so the edit would be lost. Edit the source in ai/.apm/ instead: skills in ai/.apm/skills/, agents in ai/.apm/agents/, hooks in ai/.apm/hooks/.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
